about.label: About Us
about.title: We're here when it matters most
about.text1: NGO "Veteran. Road to a New Life" is a non-governmental organization created to provide comprehensive support for veterans and their families in the process of returning to civilian life.
about.text2: Our mission is to ensure that every veteran has access to quality psychological, legal, medical and social assistance. We believe that returning home is not the end of service, but the beginning of a new path.
about.text3: We work every day so that no defender is left alone with their challenges.
